7_differentiation_hook.hook: Kingston is a straight shot east on the 401 from our Peterborough HQ, and it's a deep institutional market — Queen's University, the hospitals and a large federal and corrections employer base. 8_faq_set.q: Do you deliver office furniture to Kingston?
8_faq_set.a: Yes. Brant Business Interiors delivers and installs commercial office furniture throughout Kingston and Napanee, Gananoque and the eastern-Ontario 401 corridor. We're a family-owned Ontario dealer headquartered in Peterborough, and we coordinate a delivery window for your site, then place, assemble and level everything with our own installation crew.

8_faq_set.q: Does Brant Business Interiors have a showroom in Kingston?
8_faq_set.a: No. We're headquartered at 296 George St N in Peterborough and serve Kingston as a delivery and installation coverage area, not a storefront. You work with our Ontario account team by phone and email, and our crew comes to your Kingston site to deliver and install. Call 1-800-835-9565 to plan a project or request a quote.

8_faq_set.q: Is installation included on Kingston orders?
8_faq_set.a: Professional assembly and installation is included with most orders. For larger fit-outs or after-hours and weekend work in occupied Kingston spaces, any added scope is noted in your quote upfront — there are no surprise fees. Our crew places, assembles and levels every piece and removes the packaging the same day.

8_faq_set.q: How long does delivery to Kingston take?
8_faq_set.a: Lead times depend on the product, not the location. Stock items typically deliver within one to two weeks; custom or made-to-order pieces run roughly four to twelve weeks by manufacturer. We confirm your delivery window at order confirmation and give advance notice before delivery day.

8_faq_set.q: Can Kingston schools, hospitals and municipalities buy without a tender?
8_faq_set.a: Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers in Kingston — school boards, hospitals and municipalities — can purchase office furniture and installation from us without an open tender under our OECM Supplier Partner agreement, held by our parent legal entity, Brant Basics. Private businesses simply order direct. Call us and we'll confirm your eligibility.
